name: Putative copy-number alterations from GISTIC
description: Putative copy-number calls on 579 cases determined using GISTIC 2.0. Values: -2 = homozygous deletion; -1 = hemizygous deletion; 0 = neutral / no change; 1 = gain; 2 = high level amplification.

name: Capped relative linear copy-number values
description: Capped relative linear copy-number values for each gene (from Affymetrix SNP6).

name: Methylation (HM27)
description: Methylation (HM27) beta-values for genes in 592 cases. For genes with multiple methylation probes, the probe most anti-correlated with expression.

name: mRNA expression (microarray)
description: Expression levels for 17155 genes in 561 hgsoc cases (Agilent microarray).

name: mRNA expression (U133 microarray only)
description: mRNA expression data from the Affymetrix U133 microarray.

name: mRNA expression z-scores relative to diploid samples (U133 microarray only)
description: mRNA expression z-scores (U133 microarray only) compared to the expression distribution of each gene tumors that are diploid for this gene.

name: mRNA expression z-scores relative to all samples (U133 microarray only)

name: mRNA expression z-scores relative to diploid samples (microarray)

name: mRNA expression z-scores relative to all samples (log microarray)
